controles.affirmation: Un litige boursier en cours (recours collectif Patel v. Lululemon et actions derivees consolidees)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "On August 8, 2024, lululemon athletica inc. and certain officers of the Company were named as defendants in a purported securities class action (Patel v. Lululemon Athletica Inc., et al., No. 1:24-cv-06033)... On March 31, 2026, the court granted in part and denied in part defendants' motion to dismiss the amended complaint. The Company intends to defend the action vigorously." ; "On August 1, 2025, the Derivative Actions were consolidated for all purposes under the caption In re lululemon athletica inc. Stockholder Derivative Litigation... the Derivative Actions are stayed pending resolution of the securities class action."

controles.affirmation: Cour supreme americaine a invalide les tarifs IEEPA le 20 fevrier 2026 ; 216 M$ verses en 2025, remboursement incertain
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court invalidated tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Power Act ("IEEPA"). Immediately following this IEEPA decision, the U.S. Administration initiated new tariffs at different rates under alternative legislative powers... In 2025, we remitted $216 million of tariffs under the IEEPA; however, the IEEPA decision did not address the processes or timing for refund claims, and the ultimate amounts, if any, that we may recover remain uncertain."

controles.affirmation: Guidance de chiffre d'affaires 2026 abaissee DEUX FOIS en trois mois
controles.verbatim_source: Seules deux guidances 2026 existent dans les sources : communique du 17 mars 2026 "For 2026, the Company expects net revenue to be in the range of $11.350 billion to $11.500 billion, representing growth of 2% to 4%" et communique du 4 juin 2026 "For 2026, the Company now expects net revenue to be in the range of $11.000 billion to $11.150 billion, representing a decline of 1% to 0%". Aucun 8-K intermediaire ne contient de guidance revisee.
controles.correction_proposee: Il y a eu UNE seule revision a la baisse (mars 2026 -> juin 2026). Ecrire : "Prevision de chiffre d'affaires 2026 abaissee des le premier trimestre, de 11,35-11,5 Mds $ a 11,0-11,15 Mds $, faisant passer l'objectif d'une croissance de 2-4 % a un recul de 1 % a 0 %." Corriger egalement le hook, qui repose sur le meme "deux fois".

controles.affirmation: Pres de neuf mois d'interim a la direction generale
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 11 decembre 2025 : "the board of directors of lululemon and Calvin McDonald mutually agreed that Mr. McDonald will step down from his position as Chief Executive Officer, effective January 31, 2026" ; "...to serve as interim co-Chief Executive Officers, effective January 31, 2026". 8-K du 22 avril 2026 : arrivee de Heidi O'Neill "effective September 8, 2026".
controles.correction_proposee: L'interim court du 31 janvier 2026 au 8 septembre 2026, soit un peu plus de sept mois, et non pres de neuf. Ecrire "plus de sept mois d'interim" (ou "neuf mois entre l'annonce du depart et l'arrivee de la nouvelle Directrice Generale" si l'on compte depuis le 11 decembre 2025).

controles.affirmation: Rachats de 358,3 M$ au T1 2026, soit plus de quatre fois le flux de tresorerie disponible du trimestre (87,1 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: Communique T1 2026 : "The Company repurchased 2.2 million of its shares for a cost of $358.3 million." 10-Q T1 2026, tableau de flux : "Net cash provided by operating activities 214,440" moins "Purchase of property and equipment (127,380)" = 87,06 M$. Rapport 358,3/87,1 = 4,1x.

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle -730 points de base a 11,2 % au T1 2026, marge brute -410 pb a 54,2 %, BPA 1,69 $ contre 2,60 $
controles.verbatim_source: Communique T1 2026 : "Gross profit decreased 3% to $1.3 billion and gross margin decreased 410 basis points to 54.2%. Income from operations decreased 37% to $276.9 million and operating margin decreased 730 basis points to 11.2%... Diluted earnings per share were $1.69 compared to $2.60 in the first quarter of 2025." Sequence 28,9 % (T4 2024) / 22,3 % (T4 2025) / 11,2 % (T1 2026) confirmee par les communiques respectifs ; FY2025 : "operating margin decreased 380 basis points to 19.9%".

controles.affirmation: Stocks 1 700,8 M$ au 1er fevrier 2026, +18 % sur un an (+6 % en unites), provision pour obsolescence de 87,1 M$ a 88,8 M$ selon les sources, point d'audit critique
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Our inventory balance as of February 1, 2026 was $1.7 billion, an increase of 18% from February 2, 2025." ; communique T4 2025 : "On a unit basis, inventories increased 6%." ; MD&A : "the net carrying value of our inventories was $1.7 billion, which included provisions for obsolete and damaged inventory of $87.1 million" ; rapport de l'auditeur (Critical Audit Matters) : "consolidated net inventories balance was $1,701 million inclusive of the inventory provision of $88.8 million". L'ecart entre les deux chiffres est bien present dans le document, la formulation "selon les sources" est justifiee.

controles.affirmation: Impact tarifaire de 275 M$ sur la marge brute 2025, mesures d'attenuation ne compensant pas integralement en 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "The unmitigated impact of increased tariffs and the removal of the de minimis exemption resulted in a reduction to gross profit for 2025 of approximately $275 million." ; "mitigating actions are not expected to fully offset the effect of imposed tariffs and the removal of the de minimis exemption, and we expect continued decline in our gross margin and operating margin in 2026."

controles.affirmation: Ventes comparables Amериques -5 % au T1 2026, -1 % au T4 2025, -3 % sur l'exercice 2025 ; marge operationnelle Ameriques 25,2 % (-10 pts), Chine 42,4 % (+0,7 pt)
controles.verbatim_source: Communiques : "Americas comparable sales decreased 5%" (T1 2026), "decreased 1%" (T4 2025), "decreased 3%" (FY2025). 10-Q T1 2026, note segments : Ameriques revenu 1 621 210 / resultat operationnel 408 480 = 25,2 % contre 1 674 558 / 589 331 = 35,2 % un an plus tot ; Chine 478 395 / 203 069 = 42,4 % contre 368 101 / 153 635 = 41,7 %.

controles.affirmation: Accord de cooperation avec Chip Wilson, conseil passe de 9 a 11 membres, depart du Chief AI & Technology Officer le 13 aout 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 26 juin 2026 : "the board of directors... appointed Laura Gentile and Marc Maurer as members of the Board... and increased the size of the Board from 9 to 11 members in connection with such appointments. Such appointments were made pursuant to the previously disclosed Cooperation Agreement... dated May 26, 2026." 8-K du 13 aout 2026 : "On August 13, 2026, Ranju Das ceased to serve as Chief AI & Technology Officer of lululemon athletica inc. lululemon has transition plans in place for his responsibilities."
